basis: The dashboard chart shows a continuous downward trend from 2005 to 2014, with the endpoint temperature dropping from $23.9°C to $10.1°C. This represents a period-wide change of 13.8°C, which is a large magnitude relative to the y-axis scale (0-20+ °C). This significant decrease justifies the 'substantial-change follow-up' route rather than routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
option_label: Route the 2005-2014 temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
